description:
Bookkeeping, invoicing and tax workflows for freelancers and small businesses in the EU, including Germany and Poland. Connect Norman to ChatGPT to work with your invoices, receipts, transactions and accounts.

Create and send invoices, organize receipts, categorize expenses, reconcile transactions and review your books. Understand your VAT figures, prepare for tax returns and year-end, and follow balances back to the documents and entries behind them.

In Germany, Norman supports freelancers and sole traders (Freiberufler and Gewerbetreibender), as well as GmbH and UG companies. Work with SKR03/SKR04 accounts and DATEV exports, prepare year-end workbooks and closing adjustments, and review and submit VAT and annual tax reports.

In Poland, review KPiR bookkeeping for sole traders (JDG) and full accounting for sp. z o.o. companies. Inspect journals, account balances, JPK_V7 VAT registers and PIT/ZUS or CIT estimates. Check existing tax-filing status and UPO availability, review prepared financial statements.

defaultPrompt: Show my expenses for last month, grouped by category.
Help me create an invoice for a client.
Show my VAT figures and upcoming tax deadlines.
